ne.name: Northeast Zone
ne.bounds: Elko, Eureka, Lander and White Pine counties.
ne.note: Ducks and geese Sept 26 – Dec 1 and Dec 12 – Jan 18 (closed Dec 2–11). Snow and Ross’s geese from Oct 10, plus Feb 22 – Mar 7. Ruby Valley closed to snow and Ross’s geese.

nw.name: Northwest Zone
nw.bounds: Carson City, Churchill, Douglas, Humboldt, Lyon, Mineral, Pershing, Storey and Washoe counties.
nw.note: Ducks and geese Oct 17 – Jan 3 and Jan 6–31 (closed Jan 4–5). Snow and Ross’s geese from Oct 31, plus Feb 22 – Mar 7. Swans by permit in Churchill, Lyon and Pershing.

so.name: South Zone
so.bounds: Esmeralda, Lincoln, Nye and Clark counties.
so.note: Ducks and geese Oct 17–25 and Oct 28 – Jan 31 (closed Oct 26–27). Moapa Valley (to the Muddy / Virgin confluence) opens Oct 31.

seasonsNote: Three zones by county. Each zone has a short mid-season closure. The Moapa Valley part of the South Zone opens later (Oct 31) and is not drawn separately.

seasons.label: Canada and cackling geese, brant
seasons.note: Singly or in the aggregate. Moapa Valley: Oct 31 – Jan 31.

seasons.label: Snow and Ross’s geese
seasons.note: Ruby Valley (Elko and White Pine) closed. Mason Valley and Scripps / Washoe Lake WMAs closed Feb 22 – Mar 7, when the three-shell limit and the call ban do not apply.

seasons.label: Swans (by permit)
seasons.note: Churchill, Lyon and Pershing counties only; one swan per permit, two permits a season; mandatory check-in within 3 days; closes if 10 trumpeter swans are taken.

seasons.label: Youth waterfowl days
seasons.note: Hunters 17 and under with an adult 18+ who may not hunt. Moapa Valley portion of Overton WMA: Oct 24.

bags.detail: Seven ducks and mergansers, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.
Canada and cackling geese and brant together.

duckSublimits.note: no more than 2 hens or Mexican ducks

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset.
Nontoxic shot for ducks, mergansers, geese, swans, coots, gallinules and snipe. Shotguns plugged to 3 shells (not during the Feb 22 – Mar 7 light goose season).
All waterfowl seasons closed Dec 2–11 (Northeast), Jan 4–5 (Northwest) and Oct 26–27 (South).

Ruby Valley (Elko and White Pine) closed to snow and Ross’s geese. WMA rules vary (e.g. Mason Valley Sat/Sun/Wed hunting, Overton by reservation, Key Pittman no motorized boats, Carson Lake permit) — see NDOW’s WMA and areas-closed pages. Not drawn.
A head or fully feathered wing must stay attached while birds are transported home.

licences.d: Non-residents hunting swans need a combination licence.

licences.who: Every migratory bird hunter (except residents under 12)
licences.d: Free, July 1 – March 10; record it on your licence.
Drawing (apply Aug 17 – Sept 9); leftovers first come, first served.

geometryNote: Geometry: zone lines are Census TIGER county lines, split against the Census TIGER outline; NDOW wildlife management areas and WMA boat launches; OpenStreetMap boat ramps; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh).
